commit.message:
browser: tolerate RenderFrameHost death with link generation menu open

If:
1. The context menu is open with the link generation item in it, and
2. The RenderFrameHost crashes, and
3. The link generation menu's timeout response arrives after the crash,

then the browser, too, will crash trying to use the dead
RenderFrameHost. To avoid that, retain the RenderFrameHost only as an ID
and look it up each time it is needed. Also, avoid trying to use Mojo
remotes we got from that RFH if the RFH is dead, since the remotes will
be unbound at that point as well.

Fixed: 1329794
